SELECT dim_geography.dist_name, AVG(fact_oilseeds_sunflower.sunflower_yield_kg_per_ha) as avg_sunflower_yield
FROM dim_geography
JOIN fact_oilseeds_sunflower ON dim_geography.geography_id = fact_oilseeds_sunflower.geography_id
JOIN dim_year ON fact_oilseeds_sunflower.year_id = dim_year.year_id
JOIN fact_pulses_major ON dim_geography.geography_id = fact_pulses_major.geography_id
    AND dim_year.year_id = fact_pulses_major.year_id
WHERE dim_geography.state_name = 'Chhattisgarh'
    AND dim_year.year = 1970
    AND fact_pulses_major.chickpea_production_1000tons > 23.0
    AND fact_pulses_major.pigeonpea_production_1000tons > 15.0
GROUP BY dim_geography.dist_name
ORDER BY AVG(fact_oilseeds_sunflower.sunflower_yield_kg_per_ha) DESC

join dim_year on fact_oilseeds_sunflower.year_id = dim_year.year_id
where dim_geography.state_name = 'Chhattisgarh' and dim_year.year >= 1970
